question: 83 + (19 times 2) - 44 + 37 div 1 + 26 - 21 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS: Bracket → Division → Addition → Subtraction.

Solve bracket and division first: 19 × 2 = 38 and 37 ÷ 1 = 37.

New expression: 83 + 38 − 44 + 37 + 26 − 21.

Group terms: (83 + 38 + 37 + 26) − (44 + 21) = 184 − 65.

Final calculation: 184 − 65 = 119.

**∴ The correct answer is 119.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 83 + (19 × 2) − 44 + 37 ÷ 1 + 26 − 21

Formula: Follow BODMAS (Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction).

⇒ 83 + 38 − 44 + 37 ÷ 1 + 26 − 21

⇒ 83 + 38 − 44 + 37 + 26 − 21

⇒ 121 − 44 + 37 + 26 − 21

⇒ 77 + 37 + 26 − 21

⇒ 114 + 26 − 21

⇒ 140 − 21

⇒ 119

**∴ The correct answer is 119.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS / VBODMAS Rule

Defines the order of operations: Vinculum (Bar), Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Identity Element of Division

Dividing any number by 1 results in the original number itself (x ÷ 1 = x).

Left-to-Right Rule

Operations like addition and subtraction have the same priority and can be solved from left to right or by grouping.
